picks.what: Aleksandrovska Street, the main street of Proskurov, postcard
picks.why: colored view down the town’s main street; printed caption in the sky trimmed

gaps: P0–P3: nothing from the city itself; P5: only a crowd at a military concert (#9) and a war cemetery (#10); P6: existing 2011 main-square view kept
notes: #6 is a street scene, not a general view, but it is the only usable old picture of Proskurov itself; drop it if a stricter standard is wanted. Most hits are other towns of the oblast: #3, #5, #8 Slavuta; #4 Zaslav (Iziaslav); #7 Sharivka; #11 Yarmolyntsi; #12 Horodok; #2 is a map. #9 (Austro-Hungarian band on the main square, 1914–18) is dominated by the crowd. #13/#14 are pond panoramas in Chekman Park, not better than the existing view.
